# Events (`vb.on`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_lua_docs.py from sdk/lua/library/*.lua. Do not edit. -->

`vb.on(event, handler)` — handler signatures per event. Returning `false` vetoes where the event is vetoable (`player_join`, `block_break`, `block_place`, `chat`, `block_break_begin`, `player_input`).

| Event | Handler |
| --- | --- |
| `player_join` | `fun(name: string, login: Login|nil): boolean|nil` |
| `player_leave` | `fun(player: Player)` |
| `login_changed` | `fun(player: Player, login: Login)` |
| `block_break` | `fun(player: Player, pos: Vec3): boolean|nil` |
| `block_place` | `fun(player: Player, pos: Vec3): boolean|nil` |
| `player_interact` | `fun(player: Player, target: Vec3): boolean|nil` |
| `chat` | `fun(player: Player, text: string): boolean|string|nil` |
| `tick` | `fun(dt: number)` |
| `ui_event` | `fun(player: Player, ui_name: string, widget_id: string, event_kind: string, value: any)` |
| `player_death` | `fun(player: Player, cause: string|nil, health_before: number): DeathDecision|nil` |
| `player_input` | `fun(player: Player, input: PlayerInput): false|PlayerInput|nil` |
| `block_break_begin` | `fun(player: Player, pos: Vec3): boolean|nil` |
| `block_break_tick` | `fun(player: Player, pos: Vec3, max_damage: integer): number` |
| `block_health_tick` | `fun(pos: Vec3, damage: number, max_damage: integer, ticks_since_last_hit: integer): number|nil` |
| `region_enter` | `fun(player: Player, pos: Vec3, block_name: string)` |
| `region_exit` | `fun(player: Player, pos: Vec3, block_name: string)` |
| `player_landed` | `fun(player: Player, impact_speed: number)` |
